pages.text: Strawberries come from the Strawberry Crop. Harvest the crop once it is fully grown to get strawberries.$(br2)They can be eaten as they are or used in other recipes.

pages.title: Strawberry
pages.text: Fresh strawberries are used in several recipes, including drinks and desserts.$(br2)See $(l:whatsits:foods_drinks)Food & Drinks$(/l) for more.
